visual_requirements.focus: clean presentation of evidence or tool
visual_requirements.readability: object silhouette and important details must be clear
visual_requirements.lighting: soft cinematic highlight on meaningful detail
visual_requirements.scale: usable as inventory icon and inspect image
visual_requirements.style: same 2D comic visual novel rendering as the global style profile
